defs.def: the scientific study of the structure of substances, how they react when combined or in contact with one another, and how they behave under different conditions 化学

ex.s: I had always been fascinated with chemistry, biology, and math, but since those interests hadn't fit.
ex.t: 我不知道是什么让我决定在新学校尝试一些新活动的，但有一天我偶然参加了科学奥林匹克队的课后会议。

ex.s: When I studied chemistry high school, I reconsidered mg goal or decided to be a doctor.
ex.t: 当我在高中学生物化学时，我重新考虑了自己的目标，决定当医生。

ex.s: Bobby was assessed and his talents was / were revealed to be mostly scientific: a 66% chance of success in chemistry and 54% in physics was / were shown.
ex.t: 对Bobby进行了评估，发现他的才能主要是科学的：在化学方面有66%的成功机会，在物理方面有54%的成功机会。

ex.s: Lisa: I had a chemistry test right at the end of the first week.
ex.t: 丽莎：我在第一周结束时就进行了化学测试。

ex.s: The school adviser helped me choose the suitable ones: maths, English, chemistry, world history, and Chinese.
ex.t: 学校顾问帮助我选择了合适的：数学、英语、化学、世界历史和汉语。

ex.s: A: We had an impossible quiz in chemistry class.
ex.t: 答：我们在化学课上有一个不可能的测验。

ex.s: The other day I was showing the boys a chemistry experiment when, before I knew it, the mixture was bubbling out of the test tube spilling everywhere!
ex.t: 前几天，我给男孩们看了一个化学实验，不知不觉中，混合物从试管中冒出来，到处都是！

defs.def: the chemical structure and behaviour of a particular substance 物质的化学组成（或性质）
the relationship between two people, usually a strong sexual attraction （常指有强烈性吸引力的）两人间的关系
